summary_zh: 三维视觉感知与场景重建对于自主机器人和智能交通至关重要，然而实际部署中常常产生冗长且重复的图像序列，阻碍了下游处理。本报告研究了BCVS（预算感知的对应关系驱动视图采样），这是一种无需位姿的视图选择算法，在CPU上可实现22+ FPS的帧率，支持移动机器人进行在线过滤以实现高效三维感知。与依赖完整运动恢复结构（SfM）流程或相机位姿估计的现有方法不同，BCVS采用纯基于对应关系的评分策略，在优先考虑视图新颖性的同时保持足够的重叠以确保几何稳定性。在给定用户指定预算的情况下，BCVS迭代选择最具区分度的帧并抑制近重复帧，生成保持连通性并最小化重建损失的紧凑子集。基准上的大量实验表明，BCVS在严格预算下优于CPU友好的基线方法，并在预算增大时保持竞争力。大规模航空和海洋机器人数据的现场试验进一步验证了其实用性和可扩展性：BCVS将冗余度降低了16%，同时保持了稳健的SfM配准和高质量三维重建。

title: Data-Driven Precision Control of Soft Helicoid Robots
summary: A purely data-driven method grounded in the theory of adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) was recently used to model and control nonlinear soft robotic simulators. Here, we extend the methodology to learn aSSM-reduced models from data collected from hardware soft robotic platforms. Specifically, we learn a five dimensional (5D) aSSM-reduced nonlinear ordinary differential equation (ODE) that accurately models the dynamics of a soft-helicoid trunk robot. We then use this ODE in a model predictive control scheme to demonstrate real-time precision control across various challenging closed-loop trajectory-tracking tasks, ranging from 2D to 3D trajectories with static and dynamic constraints. We find that our methodology enhances accuracy and precision across all control tasks compared to available data-driven linear methods and model-free reinforcement learning. While we focus here on a soft-helicoid trunk robot, our methodology relies solely on hardware data and is therefore applicable to a broader class of soft robotic systems.
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven method to learn a five-dimensional reduced-order model using spectral submanifold theory for precision trajectory tracking of a soft-helicoid robot, demonstrating superior accuracy over linear methods and model-free RL on hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于谱子流形理论的数据驱动方法，为软螺旋机器人学习五维降阶模型，并在硬件上实现比线性方法和无模型强化学习更精确的轨迹跟踪控制。
summary_zh: 基于绝热谱子流形（aSSMs）理论的一种纯数据驱动方法，近期已被用于对非线性软体机器人模拟器进行建模与控制。本文将该方法进一步扩展，以从硬件软体机器人平台采集的数据中学习aSSM降阶模型。具体而言，我们学习了一个五维（5D）的aSSM降阶非线性常微分方程（ODE），该方程能够精确建模软体螺旋体躯干机器人的动力学特性。随后，我们将该ODE应用于模型预测控制方案中，以展示在多种具有挑战性的闭环轨迹跟踪任务中的实时精准控制能力，这些任务涵盖从二维到三维轨迹，并包含静态与动态约束。我们发现，与现有的数据驱动线性方法及无模型强化学习方法相比，我们的方法在所有控制任务中均提升了准确性与精度。尽管本文聚焦于软体螺旋体躯干机器人，但所提出的方法完全依赖于硬件数据，因此适用于更广泛的软体机器人系统类别。

title: Compute Regeneration through Re-Productization: Reorganizing Retired Edge AI Silicon into a Delivered Multilingual Service Robot
summary: Useful edge hardware can lose product support while retaining substantial computation. We treat this as systems design: compute regeneration here means re-productization, retaining the compute module while redesigning the surrounding product organization. Our case is GEdgeBot, a multilingual service robot built around a retired 32 GB Jetson AGX Xavier. A source-grounded inventory shows the box alone supplies inference, while the combined system exposes five on-device AI services, a seven-language speech chain, three sensing domains, and one deterministic seven-byte control boundary. AI and orchestration stay on the Xavier; finite motor-pulse generation on an STM32F407. Audits cover the six-mode control state machine, readiness barriers and sound orientation. Historical single-prototype measurements report 1,782 MB GPU memory with YOLO, Whisper-small, and NLLB-200 resident, a direct-control p99 deviation rising from 0.24 to 49.93 ms under concurrent AI load, and six of six trigger-to-follow demonstrations at 4.35 s mean latency, with conversational voice unavailable. A November campaign restores an isolated inference stack, re-measures AI workloads, and repeats control-frame runs. Driving two execution organisations with the same 6,000 measured 50 ms frame intervals shows the finite-pulse boundary removes host jitter from the pulse train but not the command start phase; its stopping bound is host-enforced, while the MCU 16-bit pulse field is unclamped. A six-check static audit exposes a host--MCU queue mismatch, and a 14-scenario replay executes the audited main() dispatcher across six modes with zero physical device opens and 54 contract-checked frames. Results support an existence claim and a reproducible architectural hypothesis, not fleet-level reliability. The 208 direct-control ratio remains unreplicated; MCU waveform capture and on-site fault injection remain open.
tldr: This paper presents GEdgeBot, a multilingual service robot built by repurposing a retired Jetson AGX Xavier compute module, and details the systems design, audits, and measurements showing the viability of compute regeneration for embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了GEdgeBot，一种通过重新利用退役的Jetson AGX Xavier计算模块构建的多语言服务机器人，并详细说明了系统设计、审计和测量，证明了计算再生的可行性。
summary_zh: 有用的边缘硬件在保留可观算力的同时，可能失去产品支持。我们将其视为系统设计问题：此处“计算再生”意味着重新产品化，即保留计算模块，同时重新设计外围产品组织。我们的案例是GEdgeBot，一个基于已退役的32 GB Jetson AGX Xavier构建的多语言服务机器人。基于来源溯源的清单显示，仅该盒子即可提供推理能力，而整个系统则暴露了五个设备端AI服务、一条七语言语音链、三个感知域以及一个确定性的七字节控制边界。AI与编排运行在Xavier上；有限的电机脉冲生成则由STM32F407承担。审计覆盖六模式控制状态机、就绪屏障和声音定位。历史单原型测量报告显示，在YOLO、Whisper-small和NLLB-200常驻内存的情况下，GPU显存占用为1,782 MB；在并发AI负载下，直接控制的p99偏差从0.24 ms上升至49.93 ms；六次触发到跟随演示全部成功，平均延迟为4.35 s，但会话语音不可用。11月的一次活动恢复了隔离的推理栈，重新测量了AI工作负载，并重复了控制帧运行。以相同的6,000个实测50 ms帧间隔驱动两个执行组织，结果表明有限脉冲边界将主机抖动从脉冲串中移除，但并未影响命令起始相位；其停止界限由主机强制执行，而MCU的16位脉冲字段未做钳位处理。六项静态审计暴露了主机与MCU之间的队列不匹配；14个场景回放则跨六种模式执行了经审计的main()调度器，物理设备打开次数为零，并通过了54个经契约检查的帧。结果支持存在性主张和可复现的架构假设，但并非车队级可靠性。208次直接控制比例仍未复现；MCU波形捕获和现场故障注入仍待开展。

title: PA-SaR: Perception-Aware Learning, Control, and Coordination for Multi-Robot Search and Rescue
summary: Autonomous SaR requires robots to explore unknown or partially known environments, avoid hazards, coordinate team activities, and guide discovered victims to safety. Improving individual capabilities of robots does not necessarily improve mission outcomes: safer motion can restrict the exploration behavior, faster discovery can increase the rescue demand, and effective guidance depends on victim responses. We introduce PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for coordinating heterogeneous local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive approach-lead victim guidance around mission-level objectives. PA- SaR distinguishes environmental ground-truth, robot-specific perceptions, and simulated victim behavior. This provides a common basis for integrating complementary mechanisms and analyzing their interactions across mission stages. We demonstrate the framework through single- and multi-robot simulation studies incorporating model-predictive and learning-based exploration, perception-based safety shielding, event-driven task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance. The results show trade-offs between collision avoidance and search completion, indicate that supervisory allocation improves search completion beyond information sharing alone, and demonstrate that increased exploration does not necessarily yield more rescues. Adaptive guidance increases rescues relative to continuous leading, without a detected improvement in mean or final victim trust or a reduction in mortality. These findings support evaluating local control, team coordination, and evacuation as related but distinct aspects of autonomous SaR within the considered simulation environments.
tldr: This paper presents PA-SaR, a mathematical and architectural framework for multi-robot search and rescue that integrates local control, learning-based exploration, supervisory task allocation, and adaptive victim guidance, and demonstrates the framework in simulation studies to analyze trade-offs and interactions between these components.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PA-SaR，一个用于多机器人搜索与救援的数学和架构框架，整合了局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督任务分配和自适应受害者引导，并通过仿真研究分析了这些组件之间的权衡和相互作用。
summary_zh: 自主搜索与救援（SaR）要求机器人在未知或部分已知环境中进行探索，规避危险，协调团队活动，并引导发现的受害者到达安全区域。提升机器人的个体能力并不必然改善任务整体成效：更安全的运动可能限制探索行为，更快的发现速度可能增加救援需求，而有效引导则依赖于受害者的响应。我们提出PA-SaR，一个围绕任务级目标协调异构局部控制、基于学习的探索、监督式任务分配以及自适应接近-引导式受害者引导的数学与架构框架。PA-SaR区分环境真实状态、机器人特定感知以及模拟的受害者行为，为整合互补机制并分析其在任务各阶段中的交互提供了共同基础。我们通过单机器人和多机器人仿真研究对该框架进行验证，涵盖模型预测与基于学习的探索、基于感知的安全屏蔽、事件驱动的任务分配以及自适应受害者引导。结果表明，避障与搜索完成之间存在权衡；监督式分配在仅信息共享之外进一步提升了搜索完成度；同时，增强探索并不必然带来更多救援成功。相较于持续引导方式，自适应引导提高了救援成功次数，但未检测到受害者平均或最终信任度的显著提升，也未显著降低死亡率。这些发现支持将局部控制、团队协调与疏散视为自主SaR中相互关联但各具独立性的方面，并在所考虑的仿真环境中加以评估。

title: Kinora: A Versioned Workflow for Text-to-Motion Generation, Robot Retargeting, and Interactive Validation
summary: Motion generation tools produce candidate trajectories, but interactive robot authoring also requires recoverable execution, traceable edits, explicit geometry, and model-specific validation. We present Kinora, a system that connects text-to-motion generation, a motion library, local agent tools, robot retargeting, and trajectory refinement through versioned artifacts. The current release uses an independently specified 52-joint authoring rig and procedural skeleton previews, separating the distributed human geometry from externally installed generation models and robot assets. Human-motion edits preserve frames outside a selected interval, while robot edits create immutable candidates whose reports govern acceptance and export. We evaluate server 0.5.1 and Gadget 0.15.2 with 156 core regression test executions, 49 Gadget executions, four CUDA generation/editing cases, a 30-frame G1 retargeting check, and a 3,600-frame synthetic G1 fixture paired with a suspended negative control. All four CUDA cases passed their numerical gates; the turning splice nevertheless retained a 14.3 cm support-foot drift proxy warning. The G1 positive fixture completed bounded simulation replay, whereas the suspended control was quarantined before replay. These results support selected integration and preservation contracts. They do not establish semantic-quality improvements, population-level feasibility, or hardware safety.
tldr: Kinora is a versioned workflow system connecting text-to-motion generation, robot retargeting, and interactive validation through versioned artifacts, with an independently specified 52-joint authoring rig and procedural skeleton previews. The system is evaluated with regression tests, CUDA generation/editing cases, and a G1 retargeting fixture, supporting selected integration and preservation contracts without establishing semantic-quality improvements or hardware safety.
tldr_zh: Kinora 是一个版本化工作流系统，通过版本化工件连接文本到运动生成、机器人重定向和交互式验证，使用独立指定的 52 关节创作装备和程序化骨骼预览。系统通过回归测试、CUDA 生成/编辑案例和 G1 重定向夹具进行评估，支持选定的集成和保存契约，但未建立语义质量改进或硬件安全性。
summary_zh: 运动生成工具能够产生候选轨迹，但交互式机器人编排还需要可恢复的执行过程、可追溯的编辑记录、明确的几何结构以及针对具体模型的验证。我们提出了Kinara系统，该系统通过版本化工件将文本到运动的生成、运动库、本地智能体工具、机器人重定向以及轨迹优化连接起来。当前版本采用独立指定的52关节编排骨架和程序化骨骼预览，将分布式人体几何结构与外部安装的生成模型和机器人资源分离开来。人体运动编辑保留选定区间之外的帧，而机器人编辑则生成不可变候选，其报告决定接受与导出。我们使用156次核心回归测试执行、49次Gadget执行、四种CUDA生成/编辑案例、一次30帧G1重定向检查，以及一个3600帧合成G1夹具并配对一个挂起阴性对照，对服务器0.5.1和Gadget 0.15.2进行了评估。所有四个CUDA案例均通过了数值门限；然而，转折拼接仍保留了14.3厘米支撑脚漂移的代理警告。G1阳性夹具完成了有界仿真回放，而挂起对照在回放前被隔离。这些结果支持选定的集成和保存合约，但并未确立语义质量改进、群体层面可行性或硬件安全性。

title: Qubit-to-Motion: Traceable Action Provenance in Hybrid QRL for Robotic Bin-Packing Sequencing
summary: Hybrid quantum reinforcement learning has been explored for robotic decision-making, but evaluations often emphasize task success, return, or convergence, leaving unresolved whether quantum circuit outputs influence constrained actions and remain traceable through robot execution. We present \texttt{Qubit-to-Motion}, an evidence-centered framework for support-constrained sequencing and simulated robotic placement. Four Pauli-$Z$ readouts provide the sole learned input to the actor and critic, while a support mask enforces admissible object selection. Each decision is recorded and linked via step indices and SHA-256 fingerprints to a sealed route, deterministic Cartesian and inverse-kinematics waypoints, prescribed joint motion, and MuJoCo contact replay. A frozen checkpoint is evaluated across five deterministic 30-object scene variants. All 150 placements satisfy support, containment, and settling criteria. A fixed-state zero-readout intervention changes $90.0\pm0.0\%$ of decisions, demonstrating dependence on the joint circuit representation. Mean macro travel is $34.537\pm0.206$~m, inference requires $8.60\pm1.27$~ms per route, and replay achieves $8.764\pm0.220~μ$m mean final position error with 0.356~mm maximum interpenetration. These results establish reproducible decision-to-contact traceability. The implementation is available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Qubit-to-Motion-Quantum-Reinforcement-Learning-F7DC}{\textcolor{linkpink}{the anonymous repository}}.
tldr: This paper introduces Qubit-to-Motion, a framework for traceable action provenance in hybrid quantum reinforcement learning for robotic bin-packing sequencing, using Pauli-Z readouts and SHA-256 fingerprints to link quantum decisions to simulated robot motion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Qubit-to-Motion框架，用于混合量子强化学习中的可追溯动作来源，在机器人装箱排序中利用Pauli-Z读出和SHA-256指纹将量子决策与模拟机器人运动联系起来。
summary_zh: 混合量子强化学习已被探索用于机器人决策，但相关评估往往侧重于任务成功率、回报或收敛性，而未阐明量子电路输出是否会影响受约束的动作选择，并能否在机器人执行过程中保持可追溯性。我们提出\texttt{Qubit-to-Motion}，一个以证据为中心、面向支撑约束排序与仿真机器人放置任务的框架。四个Pauli-$Z$读出值作为演员与评论家网络唯一的学习输入，同时一个支撑掩码强制约束合法对象的选择。每一步决策均被记录，并通过步骤索引和SHA-256指纹与密封路径、确定性笛卡尔坐标与逆运动学路径点、指定关节运动及MuJoCo接触回放相链接。基于冻结检查点，在五个确定性30对象场景变体上进行了评估。所有150次放置均满足支撑、包容及稳定条件。固定状态下的零读出干预改变了$90.0\pm0.0\%$的决策，表明决策依赖于联合电路表示。平均宏路径长度为$34.537\pm0.206$~m，每条路径的推断时间为$8.60\pm1.27$~ms，回放的平均最终位置误差为$8.764\pm0.220~μ$m，最大相互穿透深度为0.356~mm。上述结果确立了从决策到接触的可复现可追溯性。实现代码见\texttt{匿名仓库}（\href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Qubit-to-Motion-Quantum-Reinforcement-Learning-F7DC}{\textcolor{linkpink}{匿名仓库链接}}）。

title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
summary: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.
tldr: WanderBench is a new benchmark for evaluating video world models on dynamic world exploration from a single video, revealing that current models lose camera control and dynamics over long clips and fail at place consistency, while the proposed training-free WanderLand framework improves five models across all dimensions.
tldr_zh: WanderBench 是一个新的基准，用于评估视频世界模型从单个视频进行动态世界探索的能力，发现现有模型在长片段中失去相机控制和动态保真度，且无法保持场景一致性；提出的无训练框架 WanderLand 在五个模型的所有维度上都有提升。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型能够以输入视频为条件，从而实现对真实、已录制动态场景的探索，支持素材重拍、自由视点回放，以及为具身智能体构建真实到仿真环境。此类应用要求生成的推演序列忠实于所录制的世界，然而现有基准测试通常从单张图像或文本提示出发，且视频条件生成主要依据感知质量和相机跟随效果进行评估。这些评估方法并未直接检验探索过程是否保持主体身份、事件进展以及重访场景时的一致性。为此，我们提出WanderBench，一个用于从视频探索动态世界的基准测试。该基准包含745段单镜头源视频，涵盖真实内容与AI生成内容，分为三个难度等级（3至25秒），并配有以键盘操作形式给出的相机路径，通过24项经人工验证的子指标对六个维度进行评估。对八种模型进行基准测试后，我们发现随着片段长度的增加，模型能够保持静态场景与视觉质量，但会丧失相机控制能力与源动态信息，并且没有模型能保持一致的重访地点。我们进一步提出WanderLand，一种无需训练的框架，该框架将冻结模型的每一帧与同瞬间的源帧进行条件化，并在重访时将模型自身先前的静态内容作为条件。WanderLand在全部维度上提升了五种模型的表现，在源动态保真度方面最高提升达8.3分。

title: An Evaluation of Tabular Foundation Models as Training-Free World Models
summary: World models are widely considered to be a potential key component of model-based reinforcement learning and robot planning, but typically require task-specific training on substantial interaction data. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model (TabFM) can serve as a training-free dynamics model for world modeling by framing next-state prediction as in-context regression over transition pairs, and where such a model helps and where it breaks. Across synthetic dynamical systems and robot locomotion benchmarks, TabFM is more accurate than LSTM and MLP models trained from scratch on the same limited transitions in almost all settings, and among regressors fitted to the same data it is the most accurate on locomotion, while a Gaussian process is more accurate on smooth low-dimensional systems. However, models trained on the full dataset remain substantially better on most systems. When rolled out autoregressively over multiple steps, TabFM's accuracy depends strongly on how much context it is given. With a short context, its rollouts quickly degrade to the level of a trivial baseline, whereas with a long context they improve substantially and, on one locomotion task, exceed a trained LSTM. Inference is also about three orders of magnitude slower than an LSTM. Overall, in their current state, we find that training-free priors are useful as predictors when data are scarce and enough context is available, but they are not yet a substitute for trained world models in planning.
tldr: This paper evaluates whether pretrained tabular foundation models can serve as training-free world models for dynamics prediction, showing they are accurate with scarce data but not yet competitive with trained models for planning.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了预训练的表格基础模型能否作为免训练的世界模型用于动力学预测，结果表明它们在数据稀缺时准确，但尚无法与训练模型在规划中匹敌。
summary_zh: 世界模型被广泛认为是基于模型的强化学习和机器人规划中的潜在关键组成部分，但通常需要在大量交互数据上进行特定任务的训练。我们研究预训练的表格式基础模型（TabFM）是否可以通过将下一状态预测视为转换对上的上下文回归，作为无需训练的世界建模动态模型，并探讨此类模型在哪些场景下有效、在哪些场景下失效。在合成动力系统和机器人运动基准测试中，TabFM在几乎所有设置下都比在相同有限转换上从头训练的LSTM和MLP模型更准确；在与相同数据拟合的回归器中，TabFM在运动任务上最为准确，而高斯过程在平滑低维系统上更为准确。然而，在大多数系统上，使用完整数据集训练的模型仍然明显更优。在多步自回归展开时，TabFM的准确性强烈依赖于其获得的上下文长度。在短上下文情况下，其展开结果迅速退化到与简单基线相当的水平；而在长上下文情况下，其结果显著改善，并在一个运动任务上超过了训练过的LSTM。推理速度也比LSTM慢约三个数量级。总体而言，在当前状态下，我们发现无需训练的先验模型在数据稀缺且上下文充足时作为预测器是有用的，但它们尚不能替代训练过的世界模型用于规划。

title: ReVMap: Vectorized Global Mapping via Connectivity-Aware Local Map Fusion
summary: Large-scale annotation of vectorized high-definition (HD) maps is labor-intensive and costly, motivating local-to-global auto-labeling approaches that incrementally construct global maps from local vectorized predictions. However, existing approaches often overlook prediction uncertainty and rely on heuristic map integration, potentially propagating errors and introducing topological inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose ReVMap, a reliable local-to-global framework that iteratively refines local map predictions and global map construction through uncertainty-guided prior utilization and connectivity-guided global map revision. Specifically, ReVMap leverages point-wise localization uncertainty to incorporate global map priors into local map prediction, improving robustness against inaccurate prior information. It then predicts local-to-global connectivity and selectively updates the global map through uncertainty-aware fusion based on the reliability of local predictions. By iteratively coupling local prediction and global revision, ReVMap progressively improves both local map accuracy and global map consistency. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 benchmarks demonstrate that ReVMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both local map prediction and global map construction.
tldr: ReVMap introduces an uncertainty-guided, connectivity-aware framework for incrementally constructing vectorized global HD maps from local predictions, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy and consistency on nuScenes and Argoverse 2.
tldr_zh: ReVMap提出了一种不确定性引导、连通性感知的框架，通过局部预测渐进构建矢量全局高清地图，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上达到最先进性能。
summary_zh: 大规模标注矢量化高清（HD）地图既耗费人力又成本高昂，这促使研究者探索从局部到全局的自动标注方法，通过逐步整合局部矢量化预测结果来构建全局地图。然而，现有方法往往忽略预测不确定性，并依赖启发式的地图融合策略，可能导致误差传播并引发拓扑不一致问题。为克服上述局限，我们提出了ReVMap，一种可靠的局部到全局框架，通过不确定性引导的先验利用与连通性引导的全局地图修正，迭代优化局部地图预测与全局地图构建。具体而言，ReVMap利用逐点定位不确定性将全局地图先验信息融入局部地图预测中，从而增强对不准确先验信息的鲁棒性。随后，该框架预测局部到全局的连通性，并基于局部预测的可靠性，通过不确定性感知的融合策略选择性地更新全局地图。通过将局部预测与全局修正迭代耦合，ReVMap逐步提升局部地图精度与全局地图一致性。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2基准上的大量实验表明，ReVMap在局部地图预测与全局地图构建任务中均取得了当前最优的性能。

title: FaST: Factored Synthesis of Transitions for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Synthetic data augmentation promises to scale offline reinforcement learning beyond fixed logged datasets, but leading diffusion-based generators model the transition tuple (state, action, next state, reward, terminal) as a monolith: no single factor can be natively redrawn in isolation. We present FaST (Factored Synthesis of Transitions), which factors transitions via the chain rule into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, fitting each with an estimator matched to its statistical properties. Across twelve D4RL locomotion and maze benchmarks, TD3+BC and IQL agents trained on FaST transitions match the SynthER diffusion baseline while generating transitions over 90x faster. The explicit action-given-state conditional can also be re-queried for a fixed state, enabling targeted action synthesis: drawing N candidate actions per generated state and keeping the highest-advantage one under a value function fit to the same data, thereby synthesizing improved behavior during generation rather than filtering for it post-hoc. Best-of-10 synthesis beats training on real data on 11 of 12 medium and medium-replay settings (+8.9 D4RL points on average, up to +28.4), and is competitive with advantage-filtered SynthER at a fraction of its generation cost. On expert mixtures both mechanisms degrade identically, tracing the failure to the advantage estimate itself rather than to either targeting mechanism.
tldr: FaST factors transition tuples in offline RL into state, action, dynamics, reward, and terminal stages, enabling faster synthetic data generation and targeted action synthesis that improves policy performance on D4RL benchmarks.
tldr_zh: FaST 将离线强化学习中的转移元组分解为状态、动作、动态、奖励和终止阶段，实现更快的合成数据生成和针对性的动作合成，在 D4RL 基准上提升了策略性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：合成数据增强有望将离线强化学习扩展到固定的记录数据集之外，但主流的基于扩散模型的生成器将转移元组（状态、动作、下一状态、奖励、终止）视为一个整体：没有任何单一因素可以单独原生重绘。我们提出FaST（转移的因子化合成），通过链式法则将转移分解为状态、动作、动力学、奖励和终止阶段，并为每个阶段拟合与其统计特性相匹配的估计器。在十二个D4RL运动与迷宫基准测试中，基于FaST转移训练的TD3+BC和IQL智能体在匹配SynthER扩散基线的同时，生成转移的速度提高了90倍以上。显式的“给定状态下的动作”条件也可以针对固定状态重新查询，从而实现定向动作合成：为每个生成的状态抽取N个候选动作，并根据拟合同一数据的价值函数保留优势最高的动作，从而在生成过程中合成改进的行为，而非事后进行过滤。在11/12的中等及中等重放设置中，最佳10选1合成优于在真实数据上训练的结果（平均D4RL分数提高8.9分，最高提高28.4分），并且以远低于其生成成本的优势过滤SynthER方法相当。在专家混合数据上，两种机制均出现相同程度的性能退化，表明失败源于优势估计本身，而非任一目标机制。

title: Correctness Boundaries of Typed Plans for Natural-Language Robot Fleet Control
summary: We examine what plan validation and execution reports establish in natural-language robot fleet control. Commands are traced through typed plans, deterministic corrections, fleet coordination and outcome checks in a three-level Robot Operating System 2 implementation with twenty simulated robots. An offline benchmark of 44 cases checks plan structure and selected command requirements. Across five local configurations without a response schema, 70.0-87.3% of responses pass. All runs in a selected 18-run simulation series meet their pose-based task conditions. This series includes two successful repeats that replaced incomplete runs after a software change. Saved plans and logs document duplicate pickup assignments and goal adjustments within the original task zones. Separate formation traces show a structurally accepted plan with the wrong formation shape and a rejected route, and an arrival report that omitted a requested robot after replanning. Carry completion records pickup and subsequent drop-off zone presence for the same robot. The cases distinguish changes to executable actions from changes to the requirements covered by a completion report. They motivate checking the effective assignments, goals and reported outcome against the original command.
tldr: The paper evaluates plan validation and execution reports in natural-language robot fleet control, using an offline benchmark and simulations with typed plans, and identifies gaps between plan structure and actual task requirements.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了自然语言机器人编队控制中计划验证与执行报告，通过离线基准和模拟实验，指出了计划结构与实际任务要求之间的差距。

title: EgoLabel: Zero-Shot Egocentric Auto-Labeling with Cross-Modal Consistency
summary: Egocentric auto-labeling requires depth, camera pose, object, and human-pose estimates to agree across independently developed models. Differences in units, coordinate conventions, and scale can make individually plausible predictions geometrically inconsistent. We present \textbf{EgoLabel}, a zero-shot pipeline that combines off-the-shelf models without target-domain labeled training and provides explicit cross-modal registration and consistency diagnostics. The pipeline integrates MonST3R for geometry, LocateAnything with GMC-BoT-SORT and SAM~2 for objects, and V-HPOT for hands; FisheyeViT provides a separate whole-body compatibility demonstration. Our main hand evaluation uses H2O sensor depth. Across 20 sequences, per-hand depth anchoring reduces the mean of per-sequence median hand--depth residuals by $23\%$ relative to a single global scale, yielding a pooled median of $84.6\,\mathrm{mm}$ against a $20.5\,\mathrm{mm}$ ground-truth reference. Hand PA-MPJPE is $14.53\pm1.29\,\mathrm{mm}$, whereas absolute MPJPE is $119.1\pm31.3\,\mathrm{mm}$, revealing a substantial gap between aligned and metric accuracy. On three RGB-only sequences, camera ATE is $1.40\pm0.29\,\mathrm{cm}$ after $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ alignment. We also identify a sliding-window implementation issue that allows sensor-initialized depth to change during optimization. Because hand anchoring and its residual share the same depth map, the residual measures internal consistency rather than independent accuracy. These results characterize both the utility and the current limits of the registration pipeline.
tldr: EgoLabel is a zero-shot egocentric auto-labeling pipeline that integrates off-the-shelf geometry, object, and hand models using cross-modal consistency, achieving improved hand-depth anchoring and camera pose accuracy while exposing limitations of the approach.
tldr_zh: EgoLabel是一个零样本自我中心自动标注流程，通过跨模态一致性集成现成的几何、物体和手部模型，在手部深度锚定和相机位姿精度上取得改进，同时揭示了方法的局限性。

title: DPGS-SLAM: Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Dynamic Visual Sensing
summary: This paper presents DPGS-SLAM (Diffusion-Prior and Provenance-Aware Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM) for dense mapping in environments containing dynamic objects. Dynamic observations can contaminate camera tracking and scene reconstruction in visual SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping). Although 3DGS (3D Gaussian splatting) enables efficient dense mapping, existing 3DGS-SLAM systems may exhibit instability when dynamic objects violate their underlying static-scene assumption. Excluding dynamic observations can reduce their influence on tracking and mapping, but may leave occluded static backgrounds missing or weakly constrained. Our proposed DPGS-SLAM is a monocular RGB SLAM framework that supports provisional representations of insufficiently observed static backgrounds through asynchronous diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware Gaussian mapping. Dynamic regions are identified through optical-flow-based motion discovery and temporally consistent mask propagation by SAM2 (segment anything model 2). For selected keyframes, a fine-tuned diffusion inpainting model generates plausible background appearance in occluded regions, while Metric3D v2 predicts metric depth from the completed images to initialize provisional Gaussian primitives. Provenance labels distinguish generated primitives from observation-supported primitives, excluding generated content from camera-pose estimation and observed-map optimization. When previously occluded backgrounds become visible, eligible generated primitives are removed, and observation-supported primitives are independently initialized from real RGB observations and predicted depth. Experimental results demonstrated competitive camera tracking, with average ATE RMSE values of 1.2 cm on TUM RGB-D and 2.7 cm on BONN RGB-D. On StaDy4D, DPGS-SLAM improved average PSNR by 4.60 dB over WildGS-SLAM using only monocular RGB input.
tldr: This paper introduces DPGS-SLAM, a monocular Gaussian splatting SLAM system that uses diffusion-based background completion and provenance-aware mapping to handle dynamic environments, improving camera tracking and dense reconstruction robustness against dynamic objects.
tldr_zh: 本文提出DPGS-SLAM，一种单目高斯溅射SLAM系统，利用基于扩散的背景补全和来源感知映射来处理动态环境，在动态物体干扰下提升了相机跟踪和稠密重建的鲁棒性。

title: A Benchmark and Layered Evaluation Protocol for Evidence-Grounded Shared Belief Updating in Connected Robotics
summary: Connected physical systems fuse observations from robots, IoT sensors, and edge-AI modules into a shared account of the world, yet most evaluations score only the final answer or action and cannot tell whether a method attributed the evidence, updated its belief, handled contradictions, and justified its decision. We argue that shared reasoning in Connected Robotics should be evaluated as an evidence-to-belief trajectory, and introduce the Connected Robotics Evidence Graph (CREG) Benchmark to make that trajectory measurable. CREG comprises 350 deterministically generated scenarios across seven regimes (justified revision, belief preservation, relation association, contradiction onset and resolution, stale/delayed evidence, and source reliability), each exposing a normative posterior reference at every evidence prefix, validated by an independent log-odds checker and screened by a blinded expert audit. Nine representation conditions separate relation content from serialization, ordering, and metadata. Evaluating four open-weight instruction models and six transparent fusion baselines yields three findings. First, entity grounding accounts for a substantial part of the weak-model deficit. Second, deleting semantic relations costs 15.3 points of strict belief-state accuracy on relation-dependent scenarios (Holm-corrected p<0.001), but an information-matched structured list outperforms the full graph and shuffling the graph does not hurt: relation content matters where required, while graph serialization confers no consistent advantage. Third, belief accuracy is strongly non-monotonic along the evidence sequence, with mid-trajectory failures that endpoint-only evaluation cannot detect. All scenarios, references, prompts, metrics, and analysis code are released for offline, hardware-free reproduction.
tldr: The paper introduces CREG, a benchmark with a layered evaluation protocol for evidence-grounded shared belief updating in connected robotics, revealing that relation content matters, graph serialization does not, and belief accuracy is non-monotonic along evidence sequences.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CREG基准和分层评估协议，用于评估连接机器人中基于证据的共享信念更新，发现关系内容重要而图序列化无显著优势，且信念准确性沿证据序列呈非单调变化。

title: Graph-Sparse Distributed Predictive Control for Multi-Robot Motion Planning vianEdge-Consensus ADMM
summary: This paper presents a distributed model predictive control (MPC) architecture for collision-avoiding motion planning of planar robots with double-integrator dynamics. To reduce coordination demands, a time-varying predicted conflict graph selects relevant pairwise interactions. The associated collision-avoidance constraints are convexified once per MPC update using warm-start trajectories, yielding a fixed convex quadratic program (QP). The resulting QP is then decomposed using an edge-consensus formulation of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), enabling parallel robot-local optimization and independent closed-form projections onto separating half-spaces. Execution is selectively supervised by a centralized high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) QP when the distributed candidate does not satisfy the direct-execution conditions. Evaluated in C++ simulations involving 8, 16, and 32 robots, the proposed architecture achieves collision-free execution and substantially improves computational scalability while maintaining task-level performance comparable to a centralized complete-graph baseline.
tldr: This paper presents a distributed MPC architecture for multi-robot motion planning that uses a time-varying predicted conflict graph and edge-consensus ADMM to enable efficient parallel optimization, with a centralized HOCBF supervisor ensuring safety. Simulations with 8-32 robots demonstrate collision-free execution and improved computational scalability over centralized baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多机器人运动规划的分布式模型预测控制架构，利用时变预测冲突图和边一致性ADMM实现并行优化，并通过集中式高阶控制障碍函数监督器保障安全。在8-32个机器人的仿真中验证了无碰撞执行和优于集中式基线的计算可扩展性。

title: SurgTAP-3D: A Large-Scale Cross-Surgery Video Dataset with Contact-Aware 3D Motion Tracking
summary: Understanding 3D scene dynamics in minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is a fundamental step toward physically intelligent and autonomous surgical systems. However, existing public datasets offer limited scalability and diversity in real-world clinical scenarios. Moreover, annotations typically focus on either tissue or instruments alone, overlooking tool-tissue interactions. This gap limits applications such as augmented reality guidance and autonomous surgery driven by vision-language-action (VLA) models or world models, which demand large-scale, high-quality 3D supervision. In this work, we construct SurgTAP-3D, a large-scale in-vivo pseudo-3D surgical motion tracking dataset and benchmark, comprising 520K frames, 4,549 action clips, and 1.4M 2D/3D point trajectories from diverse robotic and manual procedures under unified action categories. To make annotation scalable, we design a unified framework for surgical 3D point tracking that converts uncalibrated monocular surgical videos into structured 4D annotations through contact-region prompting, active-tool segmentation, dynamic bundle adjustment, and global 4D refinement. This pipeline adapts foundation priors to surgical videos and produces temporally consistent trajectories, pseudo-scale geometry, camera poses, and instrument masks. The dataset captures realistic challenges inherent to surgical environments, including occlusions, smoke, bleeding, and rapid instrument motion. We establish a comprehensive benchmark on SurgPose, SurgT, and STIR, covering both instrument and tissue tracking. We demonstrate instrument displacement estimation, deformable surface reconstruction, and foundation-model fine-tuning. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate the effectiveness of our dataset and annotation framework for 3D surgical point tracking, reconstruction, and surgical action understanding. Homepage: https://wrld.github.io/surgtap-3d/
tldr: SurgTAP-3D is a large-scale cross-surgery video dataset and benchmark for 3D surgical motion tracking, featuring 520K frames and 1.4M point trajectories, and demonstrates its utility for autonomous surgery and VLA/world models.
tldr_zh: SurgTAP-3D 是一个大规模的跨手术视频数据集和基准，用于3D手术运动追踪，包含52万帧和140万个点轨迹，并展示了其在自主手术和VLA/世界模型中的实用性。

title: Mitigating SM-Level Load Imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting on GPUs
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic, real-time rendering on commodity GPUs and is increasingly adopted in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators. However, existing optimizations rely on algorithmic changes that often require retraining, or on specialized accelerators that lack flexibility across evolving 3DGS variants. In this paper, we identify a fundamental inefficiency in GPU-based 3DGS rendering: severe SM-level load imbalance caused by uneven workloads across screen tiles. This imbalance creates a long execution tail, leaving most SMs idle while a few process computationally intensive tiles, particularly in large-scale urban scenes. To address this, we present a software-defined GPU scheduling approach that mitigates the execution tail. Our approach uses a persistent kernel to schedule heavy tiles first and selectively chunks outlier tiles across multiple CTAs. A lightweight per-frame policy determines when and how much to chunk using tile statistics already available in the rendering pipeline. Our approach requires neither retraining nor specialized hardware and can be applied orthogonally to existing optimizations across diverse 3DGS variants. Averaged per scene, it accelerates alpha blending by up to 2.93x on a large-scale urban scene, and by up to 5.6x on its most imbalanced frames, while retaining the original alpha blending formulation.
tldr: This paper proposes a software-defined GPU scheduling method to mitigate SM-level load imbalance in 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering, improving performance in generative world models and autonomous driving simulators without retraining or specialized hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种软件定义的GPU调度方法，以缓解3D高斯泼溅渲染中SM级别的负载不均衡问题，在不需重新训练或专用硬件的情况下提升生成世界模型和自动驾驶模拟器的性能。

title: Certified Zonotopic Reachability Analysis for Trajectory Tracking on Lie Groups
summary: Autonomous vehicles track planned trajectories close to obstacles. Unknown disturbances make them deviate from these trajectories. With a bound on the tracking error that disturbances can cause, a planned trajectory can be certified as safe before execution. Existing set-based methods bound the tracking error by one invariant ellipsoid for the whole trajectory or by intervals, which are both conservative. For aerial and space vehicles, the tracking error evolves on a matrix Lie group with nonlinear dynamics. However, for group-affine systems, the error dynamics are linear in Lie algebra coordinates when the vehicle receives the inputs of the reference. The control input and the disturbance enter through the inverse right Jacobian, a matrix that depends on the error. We propagate the linear part of the error dynamics with zonotopes and enclose the effect of the inverse right Jacobian on the disturbance in closed form. The resulting tubes are tight and provably contain all reachable tracking errors in continuous time. When some error components have no input, the inverse right Jacobian leaves unmatched nonlinear terms in the closed loop. None of the tested methods certifies such a closed loop. Hybrid coordinates make these terms matched, so that our controller cancels every nonlinear term that does not contain the disturbance. Our tubes give tighter bounds than the ellipsoid method in simulations of a planar aircraft and a fully actuated multirotor and in real flights of a quadrotor, where the tube contains every measured attitude error. Under larger disturbances and the same feedback gain, the ellipsoid method yields no valid ellipsoid, whereas our tubes remain valid.
tldr: This paper presents a certified reachability analysis method using zonotopes for trajectory tracking on Lie groups, providing tight error bounds for group-affine systems in aerial and space vehicles, validated in simulations and real quadrotor flights.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于zonotope的认证可达性分析方法，用于李群上的轨迹跟踪，为航空和航天器中的群仿射系统提供紧凑的误差界限，并通过仿真和真实四旋翼飞行验证。

title: Sliding into Balance: Benefits of a Sliding Payload for Load Distribution and Disturbance Rejection in Dual-UAV Transportation
summary: This paper analyzes the cooperative transportation of a payload suspended from two drones in which, instead of being attached to two independent ropes, the payload is allowed to slide along a single rope connecting both UAVs. First, a planar nondimensional dynamical model of the sliding motion with viscous friction is presented. Then, considering stationary drones, this configuration is compared with a fixed payload with the same total rope length, both at equilibrium and under disturbances. The analytical results show that the sliding payload equalizes the tension in both rope segments for any relative position of the drones, so that no rope loses tension at equilibrium; it doubles the region reachable by the payload and, except for low friction combined with a large drone separation, it enlarges the set of admissible disturbances. Finally, a dynamic simulation also shows that under realistic gusty wind profiles, the average tension imbalance between the drones is reduced with respect to the fixed-payload solution.
tldr: This paper analyzes a dual-UAV transportation system with a payload sliding along a single rope, showing that sliding equalizes rope tensions, doubles the payload's reachable region, and reduces tension imbalance under disturbances compared to a fixed payload.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了载荷沿单根绳索滑动的双无人机运输系统，表明滑动使绳索张力均衡、载荷可达区域翻倍，并在扰动下比固定载荷更减少张力不平衡。

title: Modeling and Estimation of a Towed Marine System
summary: This paper addresses the modeling and state estimation of a towed marine system consisting of two autonomous surface vehicles (ASVs), a pair of umbilical cables, towfish, and a trailing loop cable. Inspired by the existing literature, we employ a lumped-mass modeling approach for the cables and towfish, capturing the essential dynamics while maintaining computational tractability. A Lyapunov-based analysis is conducted to verify the stability and convergence properties of the proposed model. Building on this model, we propose two state estimation methods, namely a reduced-order observer and a perfect-measurement extended Kalman filter (PMEKF), using only the measurements from the ASVs' onboard sensors. Numerical simulations and experimental results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.
tldr: This paper models a towed marine system with two autonomous surface vehicles and cables, and proposes reduced-order observer and PMEKF state estimation methods validated by simulations and experiments. The work has limited connection to the core research interests, focusing on a specialized marine robotics scenario rather than general embodied AI or VLA models.
tldr_zh: 本文针对由两艘自主水面航行器、脐带缆、拖鱼和拖尾缆组成的拖曳海洋系统进行建模，并提出降阶观测器和完美测量扩展卡尔曼滤波两种状态估计方法，通过仿真和实验验证。该工作与核心研究兴趣（VLA、世界模型、自动驾驶、具身智能）关联有限，属于特定海洋机器人应用。

title: Galilean Robots, Aristotelian Sensors: Joint Spatiotemporal Trajectory Estimation and Extrinsic Calibration
summary: Multi-sensor state estimation requires accurate spatial and temporal calibration between heterogeneous sensors. Existing spatiotemporal calibration methods typically represent sensor extrinsic parameters as a rigid-body transformation together with a scalar temporal offset, causing the spatial and temporal parameters to enter the estimation problem through separate mechanisms. While the spatial transformation composes directly with the robot pose, accounting for the temporal offset requires evaluating the trajectory at a shifted time, typically through motion compensation, interpolation, or a continuous-time trajectory representation. In this work, we formulate joint trajectory estimation and spatiotemporal calibration using the special Galilean group for the robot trajectory and the Aristotelian subgroup for sensor extrinsics. This representation incorporates the coupling between motion and temporal offset directly through the group structure, avoiding the need for a separately parameterized continuous-time trajectory. We develop twist- and IMU-driven motion priors, accommodate both ideal and non-ideal clocks, and evaluate the framework with camera, position, and range measurements. Simulated and real experiments demonstrate calibration and trajectory-estimation performance comparable to established methods across heterogeneous sensor configurations. Our simplified framework therefore offers a quality-of-life improvement over existing methods without compromising performance.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel spatiotemporal calibration and trajectory estimation framework using the special Galilean group for robot trajectories and the Aristotelian subgroup for sensor extrinsics, eliminating the need for a separately parameterized continuous-time trajectory. It demonstrates comparable performance to established methods in simulated and real experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用特殊伽利略群表示机器人轨迹、亚里士多德子群表示传感器外参的时空标定与轨迹估计框架，避免了单独参数化连续时间轨迹的需要，并在仿真和真实实验中展现了与现有方法相当的性能。

title: V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM
summary: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.
tldr: V3DSAM is an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that uses feed-forward geometric estimates and SAM-based semantic observations with semantic-geometric loop verification and geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping to improve long-term cross-view association in mapping. It is evaluated on TUM RGB-D and ScanNet datasets.
tldr_zh: V3DSAM 是一个开放词汇的语义稠密 SLAM 系统，结合前馈几何估计与 SAM 语义观测，通过语义-几何回环验证和几何锚定的持久实例映射改进长期跨视角关联，并在 TUM RGB-D 和 ScanNet 上评估。

title: ExoStack: A Modular and Reconfigurable Software Framework for Wearable Robotics Using ROS 2
summary: Wearable robots depend on a software chain that links body-worn sensing to gait interpretation, assistance generation, and actuation. Personalization further requires each measured response to remain associated with the assistance parameters that generated it. This paper presents ExoStack, a modular ROS 2 framework for implementing that chain across embedded hubs and a host computer. Its Embedded Sensing and Actuation (ESA) library configures ESP32 boards as microROS sensing and actuation hubs. ExoCore supplies multi-hub synchronization, gait-event detection, profile generation, motion planning, cost evaluation, and human-in-the-loop (HIL) optimization as configuration-instantiated nodes. The PASE desktop application edits configurations, launches the processing stages, and visualizes ROS 2 topics. Hardware drivers and algorithm plugins can be added through defined interfaces without modifying the generic processing nodes. We characterize hub and planner timing on three embedded computers and demonstrate reuse on two pneumatic exosuits.
tldr: ExoStack is a ROS 2-based modular software framework for wearable robots, providing embedded sensing/actuation hubs, gait-event detection, profile generation, and human-in-the-loop optimization, with demonstrated reuse on two pneumatic exosuits.
tldr_zh: ExoStack 是一个基于 ROS 2 的可穿戴机器人模块化可重构软件框架，提供嵌入式传感与驱动枢纽、步态事件检测、辅助档案生成和人机协同优化，并在两套气动外衣上验证了复用性。

title: BioMARS 2.0: a robotic biologist for formulating and adapting biological experiments
summary: Biological experimentation is not reducible to a single optimization problem, but requires decisions at multiple levels of abstraction: translating scientific knowledge into experimental procedures, adapting culture conditions to measured phenotypes and selecting interventions that test biological hypotheses. Automating experimental execution does not, by itself, determine which experiments should be performed next or how they should change in response to biological feedback. Here we introduce BioMARS, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that connects knowledge-guided experimental decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback. At the procedural level, BioMARS generated literature-grounded protocols and traceable action plans, improving expert-reviewed protocol quality scores across four model backends. At the parametric level, BioMARS used image-derived phenotypes from robotic retinal organoid culture to select subsequent experimental conditions, with higher reported scores in later rounds of the three-round experiment. At the intervention level, BioMARS nominated drug-repurposing candidates from biomedical evidence and advanced six candidates to wet-lab testing by researchers. Together, these studies demonstrate feedback-driven robotic biological experimentation within a framework that supports decisions about experimental procedures, culture conditions and biological interventions.
tldr: BioMARS 2.0 is a human-in-the-loop multi-agent robotic system that integrates knowledge-guided decision-making with robotic execution and biological feedback to formulate and adapt biological experiments, including protocol generation, parameter adaptation, and intervention selection.
tldr_zh: BioMARS 2.0 是一个人在回路的多智能体机器人系统，结合知识引导的决策、机器人执行和生物反馈，用于制定和调整生物实验，包括协议生成、参数调整和干预选择。

title: Generalizable Output Feedback Optimal Control via Transformers Without Explicit State Estimation
summary: Classical optimal control is used to design a separate controller for each plant. This paper asks a different question. Can one learned policy serve a whole family of partially observed, noisy linear systems? We show that one transformer can. The policy is trained to imitate optimal LQG control on a heterogeneous family of Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) systems with Multiple Inputs and Multiple Outputs (MIMO), whose dimensions, cost matrices, and noise levels all vary. A shared representation with system-wise standardization, zero-padding, masking, and an encoding of the cost and noise covariances lets one set of weights control every member of the family. At run time, a short window of noisy measurements is all the policy needs to produce a control action, with no plant matrices and no state estimator. We characterize the relation between the optimal LQG policy (represented as a dynamic state-space model) and a static transformer acting on a finite window of measurements. We then express the closed-loop excess cost of any causal policy as the energy of its deviation from the optimal action. Finally, we evaluate the approach on 28 simulated systems. The trained policy reaches the optimal cost to within a median gap of $0.4\%$ for seen systems. For unseen systems, a light fine-tuning step brings the median gap to $1.0\%$.
tldr: This paper proposes a transformer-based policy that learns to imitate optimal LQG control for a family of partially observed, noisy linear systems, achieving near-optimal performance without explicit state estimation or plant matrices.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的策略，用于学习模仿一族部分可观测、含噪线性系统的最优LQG控制，在无需显式状态估计或系统矩阵的情况下实现接近最优的性能。

title: A Physical Testbed for Self-Driving Laboratories: Comparing Bayesian and Agentic Optimization in a Minimal Closed-Loop Color Formulation Task
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) integrate laboratory robotics and automation with AI-driven decision-making to close the design-build-test-learn (DBTL) cycle. However, physical testbeds that combine off-the-shelf hardware and AI into a functioning closed-loop workflow remain in early stages of development, and their integration with commercial laboratory automation is comparatively less developed. In this work, we develop a physical testbed that assembles and integrates commercially available laboratory automation instruments and demonstrate continuous, closed-loop, autonomous operation over 24 cumulative hours of unattended experimentation. We validate this platform on a minimal closed-loop discovery task in which the system autonomously formulates aqueous dye mixtures to match a target absorbance spectrum. The system completed six independent campaigns, each consisting of 48 closed-loop iterations over approximately four hours. In every campaign, the system autonomously selected, dispensed, and measured each mixture, with an AI-driven decision-making algorithm determining subsequent formulations without human intervention. Using this testbed, we compared the performance of two AI-driven decision-making algorithms, traditional Bayesian optimization (BO) and an agentic approach, in selecting mixtures under a fixed total-volume constraint. The agentic optimizer matched target absorbance spectra using fewer iterations than BO, with reductions up to 52%, and converged on a solution for one target that BO failed to match within 48 iterations. These results demonstrate a reference physical platform for SDLs that can evaluate both established and emerging AI strategies, including large language model (LLM)-directed optimization, before their deployment in real-world applications where experiments may be costly and time-consuming to prepare.
tldr: This paper presents a physical testbed for self-driving laboratories using commercial automation, and compares Bayesian optimization with an LLM-based agentic optimizer in a closed-loop color formulation task, finding the agentic approach more sample-efficient.
tldr_zh: 本文构建了一个基于商用自动化设备的自驱动实验室物理测试平台，并在闭环颜色配方任务中比较了贝叶斯优化与基于LLM的代理优化，发现代理优化样本效率更高。

title: Concurrent Learning-Based Inertial Parameter Estimation and Control of Quadrotors
summary: In this letter, we consider trajectory tracking control and inertial parameter estimation of a quadrotor UAV whose center of mass (CoM) does not coincide with its geometric center. Onboard payloads like an IMU, a camera, or a battery are not necessarily placed at its geometric center. Moreover, during the flight these sensors might move because of external disturbances and cause a CoM offset. Thus, these events and equipment introduce an offset and cause the inertia matrix to be non-diagonal. We develop an integral concurrent learning (ICL)-based geometric controller that estimates the mass, the CoM offset, and the full inertia matrix online, without an accelerometer or numerical derivatives, and tracks a given trajectory corrected by the offset estimated online. We prove that the estimated parameters converge to their true values under a finite excitation condition. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm using a simulation example.
tldr: This paper develops a geometric controller with integral concurrent learning for quadrotors with unknown center-of-mass offset and non-diagonal inertia, proving parameter convergence and demonstrating trajectory tracking in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于积分并发学习的几何控制器，用于估计和补偿四旋翼飞行器的质心偏移及非对角惯性矩阵，并在仿真中验证了轨迹跟踪性能。

title: Same Physics, Different Gradients: A State-of-the-Art Report on Differentiable Physics Simulation
summary: Differentiable simulation propagates derivatives through a physics simulator, turning animation, system identification, control, and computational design into gradient-based optimization. Engines differ in the physics they model and, less visibly, in which mathematical object they differentiate. We separate two questions the literature conflates. The referent is which object the returned derivative belongs to: the finite computation that executed, the converged equation it approximates, or the continuous dynamics. The realization describes the organization of the backward pass: automatically generated differentiation, an equation-level adjoint solve, or a custom adjoint. The referent defines the target against which exactness is assessed; the implementation determines how accurately that target is approximated. Cost depends on the realization together with how the states needed by the backward pass are retained or recovered. Crossing the axes places every method and engine we classify in a cell, separates claims the literature merges, and shows that the apparent trade-off between exactness and memory follows from how methods have been built rather than from a constraint. A second, orthogonal taxonomy covers contact, where the map is non-smooth. We then ask whether a correct gradient helps. Four mechanisms by which useful gradients are lost are cataloged and measured on one testbed, where the advantage of the exact derivative over the equation-level adjoint depends on where the fitting target comes from as much as on the solver budget, and we review the evidence that zeroth-order methods can outperform simulator gradients in the regimes where those mechanisms act. The model classes, systems techniques and applications are surveyed through this lens, and we close with a reporting checklist, a released diagnostic that computes it, and a research agenda.
tldr: This report clarifies differentiable physics simulation by separating the referent (what object the derivative belongs to) from the realization (how the backward pass is organized), and studies when gradients are useful for solving control and system identification problems.
tldr_zh: 本报告通过区分导数的参照物（导数所属对象）与实现方式（反向传播的组织方式）来阐明可微分物理仿真，并研究梯度在解决控制和系统识别问题时何时有用。

title: SCALE: Small-Model-First Concept Abstraction with LLM-Guided Experience Internalization
summary: Autonomous agents must continually acquire reusable knowledge from experience without relying on costly large language model (LLM) reasoning for every decision. However, existing experience-based approaches often struggle to transform accumulated observations and reasoning into compact knowledge that lightweight models can independently apply. This paper proposes SCALE, a small-model-first framework that integrates selective LLM reasoning, experience-driven concept abstraction, and knowledge internalization. A lightweight model handles routine predictions, while prediction errors and accumulated cross-episode evidence selectively trigger LLM reflection. The LLM analyzes relevant historical experiences, generates positive and negative counterfactual examples, and proposes reusable concept hypotheses. Independently validated concepts are progressively incorporated into hierarchical neural representations, enabling lightweight models to exploit increasingly abstract knowledge. Meanwhile, mastered experiences are excluded from active memory while their original records remain available in a complete archive. Experiments across ten random seeds show that historical recall improves held-out accuracy from 87.11% to 98.28%, hierarchical concept knowledge increases difficult-case accuracy from 55.33% to 66.47%, and abstract archiving reduces active experience records from 6,000 to 1,528.
tldr: SCALE proposes a small-model-first framework where LLM reasoning is selectively triggered to abstract reusable concepts from experiences, which are then internalized into lightweight hierarchical neural representations, improving accuracy and reducing memory needs.
tldr_zh: SCALE 提出一种以小模型为先的框架，通过选择性触发 LLM 推理从经验中抽象可复用概念，并将其内化到轻量级分层神经表示中，从而提高精度并减少内存需求。

title: Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
summary: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.
tldr: MatScope is a benchmark evaluating language models and agents on scientific reasoning in materials laboratories, focusing on condition-specific reasoning, knowledge transfer, and forecasting in evolving experimental contexts.
tldr_zh: MatScope是一个基准，用于评估语言模型和智能体在材料实验室中的科学推理能力，重点关注特定条件下的推理、知识迁移以及在不断演变的实验环境中的预测。

title: Co-Creating Neurorehabilitation Technology Alongside Lived Experience Experts: A Participatory Design Workshop
summary: Involving patients' lived experience (LE) early in neurorehabilitation technology design can improve the relevance and effectiveness of solutions, yet LE experts are often involved only when finished prototypes are tested. We present and evaluate a participatory design (PD) workshop for early LE involvement, examine how LE contributions influence design processes and outcomes, and provide recommendations for similar approaches. We conducted a PD workshop at the 6th International Conference on NeuroRehabilitation. Five people who have had a stroke (LE experts) and 18 workshop attendees (including the LE experts' caregivers) were organized into five groups. Following the Discover, Define, and Develop phases of the Double Diamond model, each group used Journey Maps and Data Collection Notebooks to co-create a solution for an objective specified by an LE expert. Journey Maps were thematically analyzed, and group audio transcripts underwent structured extraction using a large language model. LE input shifted discussions from discipline-based assumptions toward priorities grounded in lived experience, including fear, confidence, sensory discomfort, fatigue, aesthetics, and independence. Narrow objectives, such as opening a blister pack, produced task-specific solutions, whereas broader objectives generated device concepts, including sensory feedback for cycling and a stimulation-equipped cooking splint. Satisfaction was high among attendees and LE experts. All workshop tools and protocols are shared to support adoption. The workshop offers a practical foundation for involving LE experts early in neurorehabilitation technology development. Future iterations should better capture psychological and social dimensions, allow more reflection, and include the full range of relevant stakeholders through sustained transdisciplinary engagement between researchers and the LE community.
tldr: This paper presents a participatory design workshop for involving stroke survivors early in neurorehabilitation technology development, analyzing how lived experience contributions shape design outcomes and providing reusable tools and protocols.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个让中风幸存者早期参与神经康复技术开发的参与式设计工作坊，分析生活经验贡献如何影响设计成果，并提供可复用的工具和协议。

title: 3R-Adapter: Retrieval, Rewiring, and Refinement for Efficient Adaptation of 3D Reconstruction Model
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have demonstrated strong generalization under large-scale pre-training, yet they struggle in long-tail scenarios such as low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation. We observe relational attention structure collapse, manifested as the failure of cross-view correspondences, as a primary cause of these limitations. While adaptation offers a practical way to bridge this gap, existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) approaches mainly perform channel-wise feature adjustment and lack mechanisms to explicitly adapt relational structures, leaving correspondence failures unresolved. In this work, we formulate adaptation of 3D reconstruction models as a problem of correspondence recovery under domain shift and propose 3R-Adapter, a PEFT paradigm for long-tail 3D reconstruction scenarios. Our method consists of three components: Deformable Retrieval for task-adaptive relation candidate retrieval, Relational Rewiring for reconstructing cross-view relational structures, and Consistency Refinement for injecting the rewired relations into stable predictions. Extensive experiments on low-light reconstruction, joint human-scene reconstruction, and test-time adaptation demonstrate that our approach significantly improves robustness over existing PEFT methods while maintaining efficient lightweight adaptation. Our code is released at https://github.com/PKU-OV3-LAB/3R-Adapter.

title: A Bifurcation-Theoretic Framework for the Controllability of Emergent Intelligent Systems
summary: Real-world intelligent systems must reconcile two demands: the adaptability conferred by emergence and the steerability required for accountable deployment. We show that these demands are governed by two distinct bifurcations on the same object and that, consequently, increased capability does not imply increased controllability. Emergence is a bifurcation of the capability variable $S$, with criterion $Γ:=\mathcal F'(0)>1$ equivalent to the existence of a unique positive stable fixed point of a self-consistency equation, following solely from the concavity of $\mathcal F$. Controllability is a bifurcation of the permission variable $c$, whose dynamics include an erosion term and exhibit a saddle-node fold with hysteresis as the gate criterion $ρ^\ast$ crosses unity. Three quantitative results follow: the critical exponent distinguishes families rather than classifying the transition; the gating-cost bound $K(M)\propto\log(1+M)$ grows with scope, not capability; and the fold threshold is $γ_c\approx4μκ$. Calibrated in both directions, the criteria reproduce the two-dimensional Ising transition, admit two true-feedback order parameters, and reject nine candidate quantities, supporting the conclusion that the order parameter is geometric rather than capability-related. Since permission cannot be endogenized and no deployed system has been measured to satisfy $Γ>1$ and $ρ^\ast>1$ simultaneously, increased capability does not imply controllability.

title: A Black-Box Reduction from Regret to Multi-Level Coverage
summary: Online Conformal Prediction (OCP) sequentially constructs prediction sets whose average empirical coverage converges to a target level over time, for arbitrary, potentially adversarial datasets. In the multi-level setting, prediction sets are produced at $d$ coverage levels at once. Prior work argued for the use of online gradient descent with isotonic projections, which produces sets nested across levels, but with a $\sqrt{d}$ dependence in the per-level coverage convergence rate. Here, we both generalize and improve prior work. First, we show that isotonic projections can be used for the construction of multi-level online conformal prediction sets from \emph{any} online learning algorithm (not just gradient descent). Then, through a black-box reduction, we show that the linearized regret of the online algorithm itself automatically gives control over both per-level coverage and distributional consistency of multi-level predictions via Fenchel duality. Finally, by using the Weighted Interval Score, a standard scoring rule for assessing multi-level interval forecasts, we prove that these projections reduce both the size of the sets and their under-coverage. We study two instantiations of our theory, $p$-norm Online Mirror Descent and coordinate-wise Universal Portfolio methods, both improving the dependence on the number of levels to $\sqrt{\log d}$ for the multi-level OCP problem. Experiments on several datasets show favorable performance compared to baselines.

title: A Cost That Practice Accuracy Hides: Worked Solutions in Self-Generated Training Data and the Compositional Use of New Rules
summary: A worked solution can make self-generated training targets shorter and cheaper, but accuracy on the practiced operation may hide how well a model can reuse newly learned rules. We study this choice in a 2B-parameter reasoning model learning two invented quantitative rules. The model generates targets from a rule sheet alone or from the sheet plus a program-written worked solution; targets are accepted for final-answer correctness, and the support is removed for fine-tuning and evaluation. Training questions request forward use in one segment; composition requires sequential reuse of the same rule across two segments. After six passes, using a program-checked numerical signature, sheet-only targets lead by 24.3 percentage points (95% item-bootstrap CI 14.6-34.0) on composition in a prospective test. On unseen argument values, observed forward accuracy is identical (87.5% each), but composition accuracy is 58.3% versus 23.6%, a 34.7-point gap (25.7-43.8). An independently sampled second target-bank pair repeats the direction (+14.6 points, 2.1-26.0). Ten passes on the shorter worked-solution targets, approximately matching the domain tokens of six sheet-only passes while changing other training quantities, narrow the gap to 16.3 points (6.3-26.7) in the first bank pair and 6.2 points (-6.3 to 18.8) in the second, where the pre-specified test does not hold. At six passes each, the worked-solution policy uses fewer capture tokens and less update time, yet the trained models use 2.6 times as many generated tokens per composition success under the numerical signature (2.1 times in the second bank pair). Choosing a capture context therefore requires testing how the new rules are reused, alongside the inference cost of those uses, rather than relying on forward accuracy alone.

title: A Geometric Invariant of Attention Predicts Head Specialization from Weights Alone
summary: Transformers are built with continuous symmetries in the attention mechanism. We derive $ρ$, a scalar invariant that measures each head's capacity to couple to rotary positional encodings. This framework allows us to analyze heads without forward passes, opening a new research direction into data-independent analysis of modern LLMs. Empirically, we find that $ρ$ predicts induction heads, the most-studied circuit type in mechanistic interpretability, with Spearman correlation between $-0.55$ and $-0.74$ across four bias-free RoPE models spanning $135$M to $7$B parameters. As a preliminary proof of concept, we use $ρ$ to apply YaRN to only the top-50% positional heads, which degrades perplexity less than uniform application. Code is available at https://github.com/MPedraBento/rho-invariant.

title: A Large-Scale Dataset for Cross-Lingual Multi-Jurisdiction Patent Drafting from Patent Cooperation Treaty Applications
summary: Securing patent protection across countries requires drafting claims separately for each national patent office, in the relevant language and according to its legal and stylistic conventions. Patent claims can therefore differ across languages and jurisdictions because of translation, target-office drafting practices, and prosecution-stage changes. We formulate cross-lingual patent drafting as generating plausible candidate claim sets for a specified target language, jurisdiction, and prosecution stage from a source claim set in another language. The task models jurisdiction- and stage-specific transformations beyond content-preserving translation. We construct a large-scale Japanese-English dataset by linking Japan Patent Office (JPO) and United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) records through 884,179 Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)-derived patent families. Across six released configurations, these families yield 4,067,168 directional claim-set instances; four core configurations form the main benchmark. Commercial machine translation and zero- and few-shot prompting capture part of the task, while supervised adaptation provides the strongest overall baseline, showing that task-specific patterns can be learned from linked cross-jurisdictional claim sets.

title: A Modular Perspective for Modeling MARL Systems
summary:
The growing complexity of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has fragmented the literature, obscuring underlying architectural choices behind diverse implementations. This fragmentation makes it difficult to evaluate critical modeling dimensions in isolation, identify how components affect the resulting system dynamics, and compare, reuse, or combine contributions across the literature.
  This paper proposes a modular perspective for modeling, analyzing, and implementing MARL systems. We decompose them into eight functional modules: agents, environments, learning, reward modeling, training and execution modes, communication, modeling of other agents, and evaluation criteria. For each module, we clarify its role and review representative approaches.
  We instantiate this decomposition in MARLKIT, a framework whose modules are explicit and interchangeable. MARLKIT demonstrates how the proposed perspective supports transparent experimental assumptions and the controlled variation and combination of MARL mechanisms. Experiments illustrate its ability to prototype, compare, reuse and combine modules while making differences between configurations explicit.
  Overall, the paper provides a structured perspective on MARL modeling and implementation, offering a common language for making modeling choices explicit, supporting clearer descriptions of MARL approaches, and supporting more controlled experimentation through the systematic isolation and combination of MARL mechanisms.

title: A Multi-Word Tokenizer for 204 Languages That Needs Fewer Tokens Than GPT-4o's, Including on English
summary: Languages of India need 1.6 to 14 times as many tokens as English on GPT-4o's tokenizer for the same content, which makes them more expensive and slower to serve. We train tokenizers from scratch on human-written text in about 200 languages. Havon v3 is a byte-level BPE tokenizer with 262,144 tokens and a pre-tokenizer that keeps combining marks with their letters and chunks scripts written without spaces. On FLORES-200 devtest it needs fewer tokens than GPT-4o's o200k_base on all 25 languages of India (median 0.74 of GPT-4o's count) and on 172 of 204 languages, but 7% more on English. Havon v4 adds a second, multi-word training stage (SuperBPE) to v3. At exactly GPT-4o's vocabulary size of 200,019 tokens, v4 needs 6.1% fewer tokens than GPT-4o on English and fewer on 161 of 204 languages and all 25 languages of India (median 0.74); at the same size, v3 needs 9.4% more on English and wins on 133. With 262,144 tokens, v4 needs 9.6% fewer tokens on English and fewer on 182 of 204 languages, and with 524,288 tokens it needs fewer on 203 of 204. The gains are largest for English, Hindi and the Romance languages; scripts without spaces, such as Khmer, Burmese and Tibetan, gain little and lose subword merges. Havon v5 replaces v4's Python-only code sample with permissively licensed code in 15 languages: on code it needs 1.03 to 1.22 times GPT-4o's tokens, against 1.11 to 1.29 for v4, while keeping all 25 languages of India (median 0.74, all significant under a sentence-level bootstrap) and English (0.94). These are compression results only: we have not yet evaluated a model trained with v4 or v5.

title: A Sequential Monte Carlo Method for Data Assimilation in Subsurface Flow Systems with Hierarchical Uncertainty
summary: Subsurface flow systems often involve hierarchical geological uncertainty, meaning both higher-level metaparameters and cell-by-cell properties are uncertain. This leads to challenges for data assimilation because both sets of parameters must be estimated. In this work we develop an adaptive-tempered sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) procedure for joint Bayesian estimation of these quantities. The method uses noncentered geological parameterizations, with geomodel realizations represented by metaparameters and Gaussian latent variables that are independent under the prior. Adaptive likelihood tempering, importance weighting, resampling, and blockwise Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) mutation are applied at each iteration. Flow surrogates are used for all function evaluations. The hierarchical SMC procedure is further extended to treat successive data assimilation. In this case, existing posterior particles are updated in a manner that accounts for correlations in surrogate model errors across observation batches. We consider two distinct 3D systems with hierarchical uncertainty. The first is a faulted carbon storage system containing three stacked aquifers and two extensive faults. Principal component analysis is used to represent target-aquifer heterogeneity, while geological metaparameters characterize uncertain aquifer and fault properties. The second is a channelized oil-water system containing three facies with uncertain properties. A latent diffusion model represents variability in channel geometry and facies realizations. For the four synthetic true models considered, SMC posterior metaparameter distributions and flow predictions agree closely with reference MCMC results. SMC, however, requires fewer function evaluations and provides speedups of 2.5--7.0 for single-stage data assimilation. Even greater speedups are achieved with multiple GPUs.

title: A Strict Upper Bound for Three-Point Weighted Selection in Planar Vector-Valued Regression
summary: We prove $F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,3)<11/6$ for minimum-Frobenius-norm least-squares regression with two input and two output coordinates, improving the upper bound $15/8$. More precisely, a universal $\varepsilon_0>0$ satisfies $\mathcal T_3\le(5/6-\varepsilon_0)E$ for every finite residual frame. The proof combines an exact scalar certificate, rigidity of equality in planar selection, and a compactness argument that controls disappearing weights. Together with the known lower bound, this gives $13/8\le F_{\mathrm{weighted}}(2,2,3)<11/6$. No numerical value of $\varepsilon_0$ is claimed.

title: A Theoretical Reduction From Membership Inference to Reconstruction Attacks Against Learners
summary: We study reconstruction attacks, which recover training data from a learned model. In our adversarial model, the adversary designs a hard instance, drawn from a parameterized family of data distributions, and is given the parameter used to generate it. Our main contribution is a general reduction showing that, in this model, membership inference (determining whether a given datapoint was used for training) implies reconstruction: for a training set of size $n$, a membership test with recall at least $q(n)$ and false-positive rate $O(δ^2/n^2)$ yields a reconstruction algorithm that, with probability $1 - O(δ)$, outputs only training points, and recovers $Ω(n \cdot q(n))$ of them in expectation. This reduction applies to any learning algorithm.
